The '''Reservoir Tunnels''' were a series of subterranean tunnels, pipelines and reservoirs connected to [[Vobbara Yusinduu]]'s [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Refining Factory|refinery]] in the [[Minboosa District]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:AtF" />
